name: gpt
description: Run OpenAI GPT models as Claude Code subagents on the session's own tools

effort.title: GPT effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for every GPT step. "inherit" (default) uses the Agent call's effort, else the session's; a level overrides both.

maxSteps.title: GPT step cap
maxSteps.description: A GPT run stops after this many model steps and reports that the cap was reached.

maxUsd.title: GPT cost cap (USD)
maxUsd.description: A GPT run stops once its estimated OpenAI cost reaches this many dollars.

web.title: GPT web access
web.description: Give GPT OpenAI's hosted web search: it searches, opens pages and finds text in them at OpenAI, under OpenAI's site access and safeguards, outside Claude Code's permissions. Claude sees it as WebSearch and WebFetch. Each search costs $0.01 plus content tokens. Every web action is listed in the transcript and at the end of the report.

webCacheOnly.title: GPT web: cache only
webCacheOnly.description: With web access on, use only OpenAI's cached copies of pages (external_web_access: false): nothing is fetched live, so some pages are missing.

webBudget.title: GPT web budget
webBudget.description: How much page content OpenAI's web search may return to GPT in a run. "unlimited" lets GPT read more pages, but can be slower and cost more. Applies only while web access is on.
